title: Knew Nothing About Bees and Now Makes $20K/Month. HOW?!

stated_problem.quote: When you're in this kind of business, you're always trying to find different ways to make money because honey sales can slow down on the summer and the beer moveals pick up in the summer.
stated_problem.speaker: Slobo

idea.name: Local honey bee farm with retail store and apiary tours
idea.one_liner: Start beekeeping for <$500, grow to 150 hives from rescued colonies, sell local/varietal honey via self-serve farm stand then a retail honey shop with extra SKUs, plus paid apiary tours
idea.offer: local raw honey, wax products, curated honey/gift store, bee tours
idea.revenue_model: retail product sales and tour tickets

stated_problem.speaker: Slobo

idea.name: Live honeybee removal/rescue service
idea.one_liner: Remove wild bee colonies from sheds, walls and trees for homeowners (instead of extermination) and rehome them as honey-producing hives

key_quotes.quote: People know that you do honey so they're like, okay, I have bees, this guy, he can maybe rescue these bees from my properties.
